text: The header and context actions distinguish a server-independent mid:Message-ID from a news identifier that can include the message server and nondefault port. Context message-copy excludes feeds, dummy messages and multiple selection; header copy follows its displayed-message feed/newsgroup metadata. Both news actions call the shared normalizing helper, which returns empty for a missing/invalid identifier. The visibility tests are not clipboard or encrypted-transport validation. Static source only.
title: Copy Message Link and Copy News Link preserve different message identities
